actual plant operations, sanitary conditions and available evidence

tasks.design: Configure native plant/case links and retained visit identifiers in {OPS_SYSTEM}, inspection case software. The inspector monitors real operations and sanitary conditions and captures/checks the actual case findings before saving; no system determines that a plant is safe.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated plant-history navigation and visit identifiers can add handling to required inspection records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links and visit context can retain actual inspection identities.
tasks.still_hard: Sanitation, actual operations and evidence quality require direct inspection.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a real contamination concern that a completed checklist does not resolve.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated case context around actual monitoring.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native inspection-case context can reduce repeated record handling while actual meat-plant monitoring remains inspector work.

assumptions: This is an actual inspection with an existing observation record; no extra sanitary certificate or report is invented. The authority supplies actual criteria/history; the inspector produces observations in s2 and captures/checks them in s3.
Reuse actual fixed identities and existing case links only. Missing criteria, unknown findings and identity conflicts require manual resolution; no sensor feed or structured safe flag is assumed.

Native context first; equivalent existing configuration removes the gain. Shares 10/70/19/1 are unmeasured active effort; gross saving 3 + 3.8 = 6.8 minus 1.5 hours of link/context upkeep leaves 5.3 net.

tasks.design: Keep emergency assessment, decision and action with the authorized inspector. Retain actual plant/case identity in {OPS_SYSTEM}, inspection case software, only to reduce repeated context in the actual post-action record; recording does not delay the immediate action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Emergency judgment cannot be replaced by a form, though the actual case entry may repeat identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case context can retain fixed identity for the real action record.
tasks.still_hard: The inspector must assess actual danger and act within actual authority under the applicable procedure.
tasks.human_edge: Take a timely defensible action under uncertainty and verify the actual response.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case context can reduce repeated emergency-record identifiers; actual emergency judgment and enforcement remain with authorized inspectors.

assumptions: Actual authority and procedure are supplied by the organization, not inferred from occupation or jurisdiction. If the inspector lacks authority, the actual authorized decision path is required; no new power is proposed.
The inspector produces real findings/action and captures/checks the required actual case entry in s4. No completed record, structured hazard flag or facility acknowledgment is assumed for free.

The s2 gate is the actual operational decision/check of the final direction, not an added approval meeting. Changed scope or recipient requires renewed decision. Post-action paperwork does not precede or delay immediate action.

Shares 35/25/30/9/1 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 0.9 minus 0.25 hours of context upkeep leaves 0.65 net. Native equivalent context removes the gain; negligible save is fully retained.

No extra written closure-order baseline, automated closure, hidden notification or certificate is invented. If the actual procedure requires a separate written order, decompose that actual drafting and gated issue separately.

steps.what: Collect and verify actual foreign inspection-system documents, origin-country/version identities, prior review findings and the actual U.S. comparison criteria
inputs: actual origin-country inspection-system submissions and monitoring evidence
actual U.S. comparison criteria supplied by the responsible authority
actual prior case references
outputs: inspector-checked foreign-system evidence set and applicable comparison criteria

steps.what: Review source-linked proposed correspondences between actual foreign inspection provisions and supplied U.S. criteria, checking originals and unresolved differences
inputs: inspector-checked foreign-system evidence set and applicable comparison criteria
outputs: inspector-checked provision comparison and evidence gaps with exact source references

loop.purpose: Propose correspondences in differently worded inspection-system documents
loop.input: Actual supplied foreign-system documents and actual authority-supplied U.S. comparison criteria
loop.output: Proposed provision correspondences, differences and gaps with exact page/section references
loop.check: Inspector opens and checks all retained source passages and searches for contradictory or omitted provisions
loop.stop: Missing text, uncertain translation or unsupported correspondence returns to manual review; no equivalence decision is generated
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed keyword joins cannot establish correspondence between differently worded inspection provisions

steps.what: Review and monitor the actual foreign product inspection system in its country of origin and judge whether the evidence supports equivalence to the U.S. system, preserving gaps
inputs: inspector-checked provision comparison and evidence gaps with exact source references
actual monitoring evidence and applicable comparison criteria
outputs: inspector's actual equivalence assessment and unresolved monitoring needs

steps.what: Write the actual assessment reasoning and evidence gaps in the existing review case and check the complete record and destination
inputs: inspector's actual equivalence assessment and unresolved monitoring needs
inspector-checked provision comparison and evidence gaps with exact source references
outputs: exact checked foreign-system review record and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked foreign-system review record in its intended internal assessment revision
inputs: exact checked foreign-system review record and internal destination

tasks.design: Use native country/version case links in {OPS_SYSTEM} and bounded source-linked comparison of supplied inspection documents in {DOCS}. The inspector checks original provisions and actual monitoring evidence, judges equivalence and writes/checks the real internal assessment; no model approves a foreign inspection system.
tasks.previous_blocker: Foreign-system review involves repeated source navigation and comparison of differently worded provisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links and bounded semantic correspondence proposals can organize actual supplied evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Practical implementation, incomplete monitoring evidence and the meaning of equivalence require expert assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize that similar written provisions do not establish equivalent inspection in practice.

ambition.what: Reduce source organization around actual system reviews.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 with the responsible authority and inspection evidence owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked semantic comparison can assist differently worded inspection-document review while equivalence and monitoring judgments remain expert work.

assumptions: This is actual authority-owned document/monitoring review with an existing case assessment. The authority supplies actual criteria, foreign counterparts supply their real documents and monitoring evidence, and the inspector selects/checks sources in s1. No source, translation or monitoring result is invented.

Uncertain translations, missing implementation evidence or unsupported correspondences stop for manual review. All retained model claims are checked against originals; no model-only exclusion or equivalence decision is accepted.
Native case links first; deterministic metadata retrieval handles country/version fields. Semantic comparison is only for actual provision meaning. Existing equivalent links remove their gain.
Shares 25/35/30/9/1 are unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 5 + 7 = 12; 3 hours of source/model-output upkeep leaves 9 net. Negligible same-system save is fully retained.
Final assessment writing/checking is actual review work. Changes invalidate the save gate. No hidden country notification, external approval or additional travel/inspection time saving is proposed.
unknowns: Actual supplied evidence completeness and accepted translations
Actual authority comparison criteria and existing review tools
research_questions: Evaluate correspondence omissions and source-check effort on actual review cases.

tasks.design: Configure a native checked ingredient/unit mapping and exact comparison worksheet in {SPREADSHEET}, using only the actual approved formula and supplied limits. tasks.enabler_now: Native lookup tables and formulas can perform specified comparisons on inspector-verified inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Ingredient identity, formula applicability, unusual substitutions and final acceptability require inspection judgment.

Missing approval evidence, ambiguous ingredient identity, unsupported units or undefined tolerances become unresolved comparisons for s4. No LLM arithmetic or inferred permitted substitution is used.
